description: Turn a long URL into a short 307.fi link that redirects to it. Use it when a URL has to be typed, read aloud, pasted into a message with a length limit, or put in front of a person. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly. The link stops working 24 hours after creation, so do not use it for anything that must survive longer than a day; it is for handoffs inside a task, not for publishing.

long_url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to shorten.

name: shorten_url
title: Shorten URL
